basics.name: Matt Ji
basics.label: Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
basics.summary: Engineer and risk analyst, ten years where operations meets software. I run a thirteen-host fleet from one declaration and I know what it is doing without opening a shell: a sentinel writes job status, generation age, disk pressure and PSI into a ledger every fifteen minutes and pages me on any state that is not ok. Machines arrive over the network, join the declaration and rebuild from it. Go and Python services, PostgreSQL, secrets and certificates, and a rollback that is a pointer.

work.name: Bountystash
highlights: Built telemetry ingestion for a mixed fleet: a sentinel collects job status, generation age, disk pressure and PSI from thirteen hosts every fifteen minutes, writes it to a ledger and raises a page on any state that is not ok — the system tells me before a user does.
Provisioned machines as a repeatable path rather than a ritual: PXE and iVentoy netboot, an image library, first-boot configuration and a rebuild that returns a host to the declared state.
Ran the fleet from one declaration — wanted state in the repository, each machine pulls it, nothing hand-edited on the target — with a gate in CI and on the host in front of every change.
Managed secrets and certificates for remote hosts: SOPS/age per host, an in-house certificate authority with short-lived certificates, and nftables default-deny on every interface.
Administered Linux below the application: systemd units with per-slice memory limits, cgroups, PSI as the saturation signal, and DNS, MTU or TLS faults diagnosed with tcpdump and openssl.
Built Go and Python services with PostgreSQL behind them, including an append-only event log, a REST interface and a terminal UI in one binary.
Treated a release as one step — build, gate, activate — with rollback as a pointer to the previous generation rather than a restore procedure.
Documented the platform so another engineer can operate it: host dossiers, runbooks and decision notes live beside the code that implements them.
Developed an options and hedging algorithm for weather derivatives and advised clients as internal risk manager for a large German energy trader.
Reviewed bug bounty programmes.

projects.name: bountystash
